name: The chatter personality reacts to everything
case: With the over-the-top chatter personality, the agent starts a turn, runs a command and finishes seconds later. Chatter reacts to every one of them with an upbeat face, and holds the finish's face, played as a success, more than once.
why: Chatter never stays quiet, even for a routine turn start, a routine command or a short finish, and holds its faces long: more than once for a finish (its Examples), a success
